# Lucky Hole Monster: The Interloper (the firstborn of the forest)

![](/uploads/ajaxGallery_70_nukaknights-post-interloper-lucky-hole.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

You've probably already met him in the Lucky Hole:

**The Interloper** (the firstborn of the forest)

in German: the intruder

But probably hardly anyone knows more about it. The Interloper is actually supposed to be a creature that is still **alive**, has **supernatural abilities** and even **bleeds**.

It is also said to have lured the Mothman cultists into **Lucky Hole**.

https://fallout.fandom.com/wiki/The_Interloper
